title: IBM CEO makes bold AI strategy claim
excerpt: International Business Machines (IBM) CEO Arvind Krishna has spent the past 10 days apologizing. On July 14, he told shareholders his company had faltered. E...
content_html:
International Business Machines (IBM) CEO Arvind Krishna has spent the past 10 days apologizing.

On July 14, he told shareholders his company had faltered. Eight days later, he opened the second-quarter earnings call by admitting that IBM fell short on execution.

Krishna then told CNBC on Thursday, July 23, that only 2% of IBM's software could be replaced by applications built by artificial intelligence models. 

Everything else, he argued, helps clients get ready for AI rather than compete against it.

That is a bold number from a chief executive whose stock recently recorded the worst single trading day in its 115-year history.

IBM shares rose 4.01% to $214.94 by midday Friday, July 24, up $8.30 from Thursday's close of $206.65, but the stock is still down more than 18% over the past month and sits near its 52-week low of $199.19.

What Krishna's 2% claim means for IBM software revenue

Software is IBM's profit engine. 

It brought in $7.76 billion in the second quarter, up 5%, and makes up roughly 45% of the company's revenue, CNBC reported.

Krishna's argument rests on a distinction most investors skip.

  • Goldman Sachs backs surprising non-AI stocks

  • Mark Cuban sees a problem with the AI spending spree

Most of that revenue is infrastructure software, the layer that manages data, security, and hybrid cloud plumbing. AI tools need that layer to run.

Applications are the exposed category. 

IBM's Tririga lease management product, acquired in 2011, earns about $2 million a year from Starbucks (SBUX), which is phasing it out before a 2027 support cutoff.

Put a dollar figure on it. Two percent of a $7.76 billion quarterly software business is about $155 million a quarter, or roughly$620 million a year.

Krishna made the same case to analysts on the earnings call, telling them IBM's AI strategy is the right one and the shortfall came down to execution, Yahoo Finance reported.

The 42% mainframe collapse behind IBM's AI defense

IBM's Z mainframe revenue fell 42% in the second quarter, and the transaction processing software tied to those machines dropped 9%, according to CNBC.

One quarter earlier, Z revenue had grown 48%.

The reversal came from IBM's own customers. Krishna wrote in IBM's July 14 letter to investors that clients spent late June redirecting capital toward servers, storage, and memory to lock in supply ahead of price increases.

Memory prices are climbing because AI chip production absorbed manufacturing capacity. So IBM's clients bought hardware first and pushed software purchases into the next quarter.

content_html_zh:
国际商业机器公司 (IBM) 首席执行官 Arvind Krishna 在过去 10 天里一直在道歉。

7 月 14 日，他告诉股东，他的公司已经陷入困境。 八天后，他在第二季度财报电话会议开始时承认 IBM 在执行方面存在缺陷。

Krishna 随后于 7 月 23 日星期四告诉 CNBC，只有 2% 的 IBM 软件可以被人工智能模型构建的应用程序取代。

他认为，其他一切都可以帮助客户为人工智能做好准备，而不是与之竞争。

对于一位首席执行官来说，这是一个大胆的数字，他的股票最近创下了其 115 年历史上最糟糕的单日交易记录。

截至 7 月 24 日星期五中午，IBM 股价上涨 4.01%，至 214.94 美元，较周四收盘价 206.65 美元上涨 8.30 美元，但该股过去一个月仍下跌超过 18%，目前接近 52 周低点 199.19 美元。

Krishna 的 2% 主张对 IBM 软件收入意味着什么

软件是IBM的利润引擎。

据 CNBC 报道，该业务第二季度营收 77.6 亿美元，增长 5%，约占公司收入的 45%。

克里希纳的论点基于大多数投资者都忽略的一个区别。

更多人工智能报道：

  • 人工智能蜜月期因股票抛售而结束
  • 高盛出人意料地支持非人工智能股票
  • 马克·库班 (Mark Cuban) 认为人工智能支出热潮存在问题

大部分收入来自基础设施软件，即管理数据、安全和混合云管道的层。 人工智能工具需要该层才能运行。

应用程序是公开的类别。

IBM 于 2011 年收购的 Tririga 租赁管理产品每年从星巴克 (SBUX) 获得约 200 万美元收入，但星巴克将在 2027 年支持截止之前逐步淘汰该产品。

在上面贴上美元数字。 季度软件业务价值 77.6 亿美元，其中 2% 约为每季度 1.55 亿美元，即每年约 6.2 亿美元。

据雅虎财经报道，克里希纳在财报电话会议上向分析师提出了同样的理由，告诉他们 IBM 的人工智能战略是正确的，而不足之处在于执行力。

IBM AI防御背后42%的大型机崩溃

据 CNBC 报道，第二季度 IBM Z 大型机收入下降了 42%，与这些机器相关的交易处理软件下降了 9%。

一个季度前，Z 收入增长了 48%。

这一转变来自于 IBM 自己的客户。 Krishna 在 IBM 7 月 14 日致投资者的信中写道，客户在 6 月底将资金转向服务器、存储和内存，以在价格上涨之前锁定供应。

由于人工智能芯片生产吸收了制造产能，内存价格正在攀升。 因此，IBM 的客户首先购买硬件，然后将软件采购推迟到下个季度。
